from donations import load_donations, ROWS
from distinct import new_donors

EXPECTED = list(dict.fromkeys(k for k, _ in ROWS))


def test_called_twice():
    data = list(load_donations())
    new_donors(data)
    assert new_donors(data) == EXPECTED


def test_three_calls_with_generators():
    new_donors(load_donations())
    new_donors(load_donations())
    assert new_donors(load_donations()) == EXPECTED


def test_known_values_left_out():
    data = list(load_donations())
    assert new_donors(data, {EXPECTED[0]}) == EXPECTED[1:]


def test_seen_is_updated():
    seen = set()
    new_donors(list(load_donations()), seen)
    assert seen == set(EXPECTED)
